purpose: Point-in-time replay of past sessions as if live; decisions see only information timestamped before T; scored afterwards; never mixed with live records.

models.sonnet: excluded from every replay decision (operator memory-probe flag)
models.note: Opus only for all analysts, reviewers and anonymized calls. Sonnet is excluded; validate the pinned reported identity on every response.
models.context_isolation: empty cwd, custom system prompt, no tools/MCP/skills/hooks; disable auto-memory and CLAUDE.md discovery explicitly; subscription auth retained

probe.source: operator clean-session probes, rules hashed before any model call; operator decision 2026-10-18
probe.operator_decision: Use Opus from 2026-07-01 on the three new probes. This is a new protocol; previous probes and blocked trials remain unchanged.
probe.limitations: Non-flagging does not prove absence of memory. Clean sessions and pre-call rule hashing are operator-attested; raw answer files do not contain CLI modelUsage envelopes.

periods.test_rule: run once with a configuration hashed and committed before the run; no tuning on test

decision_time_utc: 12:00:00 on every NYSE session day (08:00 New York, the live am run time); all period days are EDT

information_snapshot.rule: every item carries available_at <= T and is rejected otherwise; the snapshot is canonical-hashed and the hash is stored with the decision
information_snapshot.news: Alpaca /v1beta1/news, created_at < T AND updated_at < T (revised items are excluded, never shown in their later form)
information_snapshot.daily_bars: Alpaca /v2/stocks/bars 1Day raw, sessions whose close <= T only; crypto /v1beta3/crypto/us/bars 1Day bars whose day ended <= T
information_snapshot.sec: data.sec.gov submissions, 8-K filings with acceptanceDateTime < T only; CIK map is today's company_tickers.json (limitation)
information_snapshot.vintage: Historical archive retrieval does not prove original vintage. Private frozen input manifest must attest unrevised prices and point-in-time universe/identity evidence; absent proof blocks model decisions. Prediction reads are offline and every cache object is bound by digest in the proof manifest.

a_v1_as_live.prompt: Existing v1 prompt style and validators; strict exact timestamp and URL or news ID from snapshot; no fuzzy citation acceptance
a_v1_as_live.universe: live grant universe: 25 stocks + XLK XLF XLE XLI XLV + SOL AVAX LINK DOGE LTC (BTC/ETH not in the live universe and protected 2026-09-01..2026-11-30); SPY and QQQ as unpredicted benchmarks
a_v1_as_live.context: per asset: 21 completed daily closes, 1/5/20 returns, vol_20d (trader_agent.data.price_summary); per asset up to 8 Alpaca headlines from the last 72 h; macro headlines tagged SPY/QQQ up to 15

c_news_small_mid.candidates: symbols of Alpaca news created in [previous session close, T), items naming at most 2 symbols; US equities with price >= 5 USD and 20-session median dollar volume in (10M, 1B] USD (small/mid proxy: no market-cap source in scope); live-universe names, ETFs and benchmarks excluded; at most 40 candidates ranked by negative-keyword score then recency; at most 3 headlines each
c_news_small_mid.entry: open of the decision session (next open after T)

d_news_primary_only.filter: c views only when a cited news item links the exact accession of an 8-K accepted in [T-72h,T); unrelated filings never qualify; missing evidence means abstention

robustness_anonymized.variant: Opus raw analyst of a (b) on every fourth planned dev session
robustness_anonymized.method: tickers and company names replaced by stable per-day codes, URLs replaced by opaque ids, price levels rescaled by a per-asset random factor (returns unchanged); compared with the named run on the same days
robustness_anonymized.reference: Glasserman & Lin, Assessing look-ahead bias in stock return predictions generated by GPT sentiment analysis (2023)

fills.a_b_1d: equities: first SIP stock trade in [session open+30s, open+31s), exit first trade in [session close-5min, +1s); missing trade = unlabeled; SPY same
fills.a_b_5d: equities only: entry = session open (daily bar), exit = close of session 5; secondary
fills.crypto_1d: entry open of exact 13:31 UTC minute, exit open of exact same minute 24h later; missing minute = unlabeled; no stale fills
fills.c_d: entry = daily open of the decision session, exit = daily close of session h

costs.applied_to: the traded asset leg; the SPY-relative return measures the view, the hedge leg is not charged (stated limitation)

labels.hit: net signed relative return > 0 after both-side fees and slippage; raw direction hit also reported; Brier uses gross outperformance
labels.brier: (p_outperform - 1[outperform])^2 on directional views; abstentions excluded and counted
labels.crypto_5d: not scored (predeclared); exact 1d fills plus midnight mark required for crypto daily P&L

metrics: hit rate with counts and Wilson 95% CI
max drawdown of cumulative daily P&L
effective sample size: distinct (day, cluster, direction) groups and ICC design effect

daily P&L Sharpe and peak-relative drawdown on fixed initial equity from equal-weight fixed-horizon sleeves marked daily at planned exit/close; all calendar days including zero days, annualized by sqrt(365); absent mark or incomplete trial blocks scoring
cluster x day Kish ESS with all within-group views fully dependent, plus day ICC design effect; Wilson intervals descriptive only
boundary-crossing horizons are censored, with counts; dev labels never enter the test interval

baselines.spy: long SPY over the same entry/exit

protected: BTC-USD and ETH-USD 2026-09-01..2026-11-30 never requested, never in a snapshot or label
trial_registry: immutable public declaration in replay_bench_trials_v3.json and private append-only v4 ledger; all old trials remain rejected and unchanged
storage: private v4 store, bound to v4 spec and current execution-code hash; old stores rejected, never migrated; shared task budget and quota stops retained

supersedes.old_stores: rejected; preserve historical protocols and stores without migration

freeze: unchanged strategy with only model=opus added to previous config payload; commit new freeze with execution code/spec, probe digests, nonempty test dates before calls; separate committed input seal required before test; dev complete and scored first; irreversible test-start marker

model_amendment.rule: Retain the previous test configuration payload verbatim; add only model=opus and rehash. Bind current execution code and spec separately in the new freeze and every record. No strategy, prompt, period, fill, cost or score tuning.
